SUPPORT SERVICES CONTRACT

This contract is made between Kestrel Facilities Ltd, which provides the services,
and Marlow Community Trust, which receives them.
The services begin on 1 November 2026 and finish on 31 October 2027.
The client will pay a total of GBP 18,500.00.
The law of Scotland applies to this contract.
Either party may terminate on 45 days written notice.
